rows.label:
art - local file domain

This stores media files you have imported. You can have multiple local file domains, and files may be in multiple local file domains at once. Each domain is completely isolated from one another when you perform a file or tag search (if your search page is pointed at A, you will not get any file search results or tag autocomplete suggestions from B).

rows.label:
my files - local file domain

This stores media files you have imported. You can have multiple local file domains, and files may be in multiple local file domains at once. Each domain is completely isolated from one another when you perform a file or tag search (if your search page is pointed at A, you will not get any file search results or tag autocomplete suggestions from B).

local notes - local file notes service

This stores your file notes.

Notes are not removed when files are deleted, and if you later re-import the file, you will see it still has its notes.

counter - local inc/dec rating service

This stores inc/dec ratings.

Ratings are not removed when files are deleted, and if you later re-import the file, you will see it still has its ratings.

favourites - local like/dislike rating service

This stores like/dislike ratings.

Ratings are not removed when files are deleted, and if you later re-import the file, you will see it still has its ratings.

stars - local numerical rating service

This stores numerical ratings.

Ratings are not removed when files are deleted, and if you later re-import the file, you will see it still has its ratings.

downloader tags - local tag domain

This stores tag mappings (tag-file pairs) that you have added/imported. You can have multiple local tag domains, and the exact same mappings map appear in multiple domains.

Tags are not removed when files are deleted, and if you later re-import the file, you will see it still has its tags.

The "all known tags" service is a union of all local tag services and tag repositories.

rows.label:
trash - local trash file domain

This is where your files go when they have been removed from all your local file domains. It is a waiting area to allow for undeletes of mistakes. When files are deleted from this place, they are physically deleted.

repository updates - local update file domain

This holds repository update files if you decide to sync with a file or tag repository. It is full of zipped up JSON and is not covered by "combined local file domains" like the normal local file domains. You can generally ignore it.

all known files - virtual combined file domain

This is a special view on a tag service. It will deliver results without any cross-reference with a known file service, and thus if the file is tagged on a service, you will see it whether you have it, had it, or have never had it.

hydrus local file storage - virtual combined local file domain

This represents all files currently tracked and stored in your database. If a file is in here, it is either in "repository updates", "combined local file domains", or "trash", and it should be loadable from disk.

When a file is deleted from the trash, it also leaves this domain and is scheduled to be physically deleted--which usually happens within a few seconds.

combined local file domains - virtual combined local media domain

This represents all files currently in any of your local file domains. You start with only "my files", but if you add more, this is a convenient umbrella that unions all of them with efficient search tech. When a file is deleted from all of its local file domains, it leaves this service and enters the trash.

all known tags - virtual combined tag domain

This is a union of all your local tag domains and remote tag repositories.

deleted from anywhere - virtual deleted file service

This represents all the files that have ever been deleted from any location. It is for advanced technical jobs, and you can generally ignore it.
